Problem.description: An RFC 9457 Problem Details object. code is one of: 401 unauthenticated; 403 access_denied; 404 not_found; 409 conflict; 422 validation_error; 422 user_error; 422 invalid_request; 500 internal_error. See /docs/api/errors for what each means.

Context.description: Context for the call, such as lang, tz and allowed_company_ids.

instance.description: An opaque id for this occurrence; present on 5xx only.

type.description: A reference to the error code's entry on /docs/api/errors.

Ids.description: Record ids the method is called on.

activity_exception_decoration.description: Type of the exception activity on record.
activity_exception_decoration.title: Activity Exception Decoration

activity_exception_icon.description: Icon to indicate an exception activity.
activity_exception_icon.title: Icon

activity_state.description:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.
activity_state.title: Activity State

date_begin.description: When the event is scheduled to take place (expressed in your local timezone on the form view).
date_begin.title: Start Date

date_tz.description: Indicates the timezone in which the event dates/times will be displayed on the website.
date_tz.title: Display Timezone

event_registrations_open.description:
Registrations are open if:
- the event is not ended or not cancelled
- there are seats available on event
- the tickets are sellable (if ticketing is used)
event_registrations_open.title: Registration open

event_registrations_sold_out.description: The event is sold out if no more seats are available on event. If ticketing is used and all tickets are sold out, the event will be sold out.
event_registrations_sold_out.title: Sold Out

event_registrations_started.description: registrations have started if the current datetime is after the earliest starting date of tickets.
event_registrations_started.title: Registrations started

event_type_id.description: Choose a template to auto-fill tickets, communications, descriptions and other fields.
event_type_id.title: Template

event_url.description: Link where the online event will take place.
event_url.title: Online Event URL

is_multi_slots.description: Allow multiple time slots. The communications, the maximum number of attendees and the maximum number of tickets registrations are defined for each time slot instead of the whole event.
is_multi_slots.title: Is Multi Slots

lang.description: All the communication emails sent to attendees will be translated in this language.
lang.title: Language

message_has_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.title: Message Delivery error

message_has_error_counter.description: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.title: Number of errors

message_has_sms_error.description: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.title: SMS Delivery error

message_needaction.description: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.title: Action Needed

sale_order_lines_ids.title: All sale order lines pointing to this event

seats_max.description: For each event you can define a maximum registration of seats(number of attendees), above this number the registrations are not accepted. If the event has multiple slots, this maximum number is applied per slot.
seats_max.title: Maximum Attendees

start_sale_datetime.description: If ticketing is used, contains the earliest starting sale date of tickets.
start_sale_datetime.title: Start sale date

start_today.description: Whether event is going to start today if still not ongoing
start_today.title: Start Today

ticket_instructions.description: This information will be printed on your tickets.

website_url.description: The full relative URL to access the document through the website.
